description: This PHP class defines the AWS Route53Client, a client for interacting with Amazon Route 53 DNS service. It provides method signatures for various API operations and implements internal methods for cleaning resource IDs.

classes.name: Route53Client
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Route 53 service, extending AwsClient, with additional methods for ID cleaning and request handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the client with provided configuration and appends a custom ID cleaning handler.

methods.name: cleanIdFn
methods.description: Returns a closure that injects ID cleaning logic into API requests.

methods.name: cleanId
methods.description: Removes specific path segments from resource IDs to normalize them.
